label: PF Backlog 186
title: Backend: per-agent runtime MODEL OVERRIDE store + precedence (override > stage > agent > default)
body:
## Problem / why
The dashboard (BI-0132) needs to change a SINGLE agent's model at runtime and have it PERSIST, but
the backend has no per-agent override. `core/orchestrator/model_router.py:get_agent_model_config`
resolves the model from the TIER CONFIG only (stage.model > parent-stage > agent.model > default_model).
Changing a model today means editing `config/model-tier.json`.

## Goal & value
A persisted, project-scoped per-agent model OVERRIDE with precedence
`override > stage > agent > default`, so the dashboard can set/clear an agent's model and the
pipeline honours it on the next run.

## In scope
- Single-writer store for per-agent model overrides (project scope).
- Resolution precedence integrated into `model_router.get_agent_model_config`.
- Read/write API: get effective model + SOURCE (override|tier|default); set/clear override.

## Out of scope
- The dashboard UI (BI-0132). - Model catalog/pricing (BI-0173) and fit (BI-0077).
- Auto model selection (owner: tier_builder, BI-0174).

## Flow
1. `get_agent_model_config(agent, stage)` checks the override store FIRST; if present returns
   `{model, source: "override"}`.
2. Dashboard `GET` returns effective `{model, source}`; `PUT` writes/clears the override.
3. The next run / re-run resolves the overridden model.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Given an override for agent A set to M', when `get_agent_model_config(A)` runs, then it returns M'
  with source=override.
- Given no override, resolution is UNCHANGED (stage > agent > default).
- Given an override is cleared, resolution falls back and the store entry is removed.

## Data model (what is stored, where, owner)
- NEW store: per-agent model overrides (project-scoped), e.g.
  `products/<project>/agent-model-overrides.json`; single writer = the new module; register it in
  `config/store-registry.json` (kind `control`, scope `project`).

## API contract (internal + HTTP)
- `get_override(project, agent) -> {model} | None`
- `set_override(project, agent, model, note)`
- `clear_override(project, agent)`
- HTTP (dashboard layer): `GET/PUT /api/agents/{agent}/model`

## Edge cases & errors
- Override model not in catalog -> allow, flag unverified.
- Sub-agents inherit the parent's resolved model (keep existing inheritance; override applies to the
  resolved agent).
- Concurrent write -> last-writer-wins with `updated_at`.

## Dependencies & links
- Consumed by: BI-0132 (dashboard), BI-0121 (agent/model SSOT), BI-0046 (stop/re-run), BI-0077 (fit).

## Open questions
- Scope: per-project only, or also a global override?
- Granularity: per `(agent)` or per `(agent, stage)`?

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: precedence `override > stage > agent > default`; set + clear.
- Integration: `model_router` returns the override; the pipeline uses it.
- Store registered; `compileall` + `wired_audit` green.

dashboard_impact.reason: Enables the dashboard Agents window (BI-0132) to change an agent's model at runtime.
